name: io.github.kd-011/klipper-doctor-mcp
title: Klipper Doctor
description: Read-only Klipper diagnosis: explains why a print died and lints printer.cfg.

environmentVariables.name: MOONRAKER_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of Moonraker, for example http://printer.local:7125. Optional: without it, logs and configs can still be passed as text or a file path.

environmentVariables.name: MOONRAKER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Sent as the X-Api-Key header, if Moonraker needs one.

environmentVariables.name: MOONRAKER_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Sent as an Authorization Bearer header, if Moonraker needs one.

environmentVariables.name: KLIPPER_DOCTOR_ALLOWED_DIRS
environmentVariables.description: Colon-separated directories. When set, the path option can only read files inside them.
